scientific_integrity: An analytic proof covers all real even self-Fourier polynomial Gaussians of degree at most four in every integer dimension at least two. Finite computations are supplementary, not a substitute for proof.
scientific_limitations: Restricted finite-dimensional Gaussian–Hermite shell; neither unrestricted definite-set sign uncertainty nor negative Fourier eigenfunctions are classified. Earlier equivalents remain a bibliographic risk.
title: Sharp negative-set volume and radial rigidity in the first positive Fourier–Hermite shell
